items.claim: Jackson McVey attacks the body well, which can break Wes Schultz down and take wind out of his sails.
items.quote: attacks the body well like McVey does, I think you can take some wind out of the sails, start to kind of break Schultz down

items.claim: Wes Schultz has good enough submission defense to not be submitted by Jackson McVey.
items.quote: Wes's, you know, submission defense is good enough to not be submitted by Jackson McVey.

items.claim: Jackson McVey is going to be in trouble if Wes Schultz is able to get the fight to the floor.
items.quote: if Schultz is able to get this fight to the floor, I think McVey is going to be in some trouble.

items.claim: Jackson McVey has improved his takedown defense.
items.quote: I do think he's improved with the takedown defense.

items.claim: Wes Schultz has been seen to slow down in fights before.
items.quote: a guy that we've seen slow down um in fights before.

items.claim: Jackson McVey is a little bit taller and utilizes tall man defense.
items.quote: McVey a little bit taller, does have some of that tall man defense

items.claim: Stan Dorsainville has only had five pro fights making his UFC debut.
items.quote: who's only had five pro fights

items.claim: Stan Dorsainville is 5'10 with a 76-inch reach, giving him a massive reach advantage.
items.quote: He's 5'10 with a 76 in reach. He's going to have a massive reach advantage here.

items.claim: Stan Dorsainville often pressures forward and walks into range, taking away his own reach advantage.
items.quote: a lot of the time he just pressures forward and kind of walks into range and kind of, you know, crushes the space and takes away some of that reach that he has.

items.claim: Stan Dorsainville has a good ground game and submission skill set, including a nasty guillotine.
items.quote: He's got a good ground game. He's got a good submission skill set, right? We've seen that. You know, he's able to get guys backs. You know, the guillotine is nasty.
